request: Analyze GSE310294 for PMID 41555288 (Effect of moderate-intensity treadmill exercise on bone quality in adult rats and the underlying mechanisms.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Novogene) of left tibia bone tissue
final.organism: Rattus norvegicus, male SD, 18 weeks at purchase (S2.1.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: n = 3 rats per group sequenced (FIG5 legend); 20 rats randomized overall (S2.1.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 6-week moderate-intensity treadmill exercise vs sedentary control on tibial bone gene expression in adult male rats
planned_contrasts: Exercise vs Ctrl (S3.3.p1; paper: 2076 DEGs, 1552 up / 524 down)

paper_threshold.note: 'classic criteria (Fold Change < -2 or > 2)'; no p/q cutoff stated

paper_results.enrichment: GO/KEGG on DEGs (FDR<0.05 terms), GSEA v4.1.0

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1 randomization into Ctrl and Exercise; S2.6.p1 left tibia RNA-seq by Novogene, DEGseq for DE, GO/KEGG with term FDR<0.05, GSEA; S3.3.p1 FC criterion and 2076 DEGs (1552 up, 524 down); S3.3.p3 named upregulated bone-formation genes; FIG5 n = 3 rats per group; DA.p1 deposits GSE310294.

checks: GEO: Rattus norvegicus bone, 3 'control' + 3 'exercised' samples, matching the paper's n = 3 per group

alignment.reasoning: The deposited matrix columns sample1_FPKM..sample6_FPKM were renamed to GSM ids by an explicit name match against GEO 'description' ('Library name: Sample N') in prep_rename_columns.py (no positional alignment). Exact index match then gives 6/6. grp derived from characteristics treatment (no -> Ctrl, exercise -> EX), which agrees with titles 'bone, control/exercised, repN'.

candidates.reason_rejected: column names say _FPKM, but every value is an integer (integer fraction 1.0), median 2, column sums 14.1M-18.1M (library-size scale), and GEO data_processing says the supplementary file holds raw fragment counts; FPKM values would be non-integer

matrix.reasoning: Integer values with library-scale column sums; data_processing: 'Supplementary files format and content: ... raw fragment counts for each Sample'. The _FPKM suffix is a labelling error. data_processing also contains boilerplate inconsistencies (hg38, mm10) while feature IDs are rat ENSRNOG, so confidence is medium.

design.reasoning: Two-arm randomized design (S2.1.p1); single factor; 3 vs 3 independent rats. All male, so no sex split.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one tissue, no batch or pairing recorded in GEO or the paper.

paper_route.reason: DEGseq (MA-plot/Poisson random-sampling model) has no executor in this repository; DESeq2 is the validated raw-count route with replicate-based dispersion

method.reasoning: Raw counts, 3 vs 3 replicates: DESeq2 negative-binomial Wald test. The paper used DEGseq via Novogene, which is not available; declared deviation.

final.deviation_note: Paper states only |FC| > 2 (S3.3.p1) and no significance cutoff. Applied rule = paper's |log2FC| > 1 plus the workflow-default significance (BH padj < 0.05). Audit = pure workflow default (padj < 0.05, no FC).

threshold.reasoning: S3.3.p1 'Fold Change < -2 or > 2' with no p/q rule; the significance part is the workflow default, so the source is workflow_default with the paper's FC cutoff kept.

caveats: paper significance cutoff unstated; padj<0.05 assumed
matrix columns mislabelled _FPKM; treated as raw counts
